title: Liquidity bot
description: 1:1 Grafana rendering of the liquidity bot's own dashboard, fed by the exporter sidecar on the VM. Five linked boards mimic the SPA's tabs — use the Dashboard/Orders/PnL/Performance/Logs links above (they carry theme=light so the suite matches the SPA's look). Refresh is 1m polling, not WebSocket-live. On a relative range (the default now-24h) the header and the inventory show the live state, the last 5 minutes, and trades and transfers show the last 30 days. An absolute range shows that range's data in every panel. Open it with &autofitpanels (the Dashboard tab link does) to fill the window height like the SPA. Full history and drilldowns: the IAP dashboard at https://liquidity.t0trade.com (production), or gcloud compute start-iap-tunnel <vm> 8080 --local-host-port=localhost:8080 --zone europe-west3-b --project $env (VM name = project id)

list.label: Environment
list.description: GCP project id — both the Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging queries take it directly.

panels.description: The SPA header: settings pills, Config, the CLI recovery guide, the deployed commit, uptime, and whether the exporter reaches the bot's /health.

promQLQuery.expr: label_replace(max(liq_up), "k", "up", "", "") or label_replace(time() - max(liq_bot_start_timestamp_seconds), "k", "uptime", "", "") or label_replace(max by (git_commit) (timestamp(liq_bot_info)), "k", "commit", "", "") or label_replace(max by (broker, log_level, wallet_kind, wallet_address, orderbook, turnkey_organization, server_port) (liq_settings_info), "k", "info", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_equity_target), "k", "equity_target", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_equity_deviation), "k", "equity_deviation", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_usdc_target), "k", "usdc_target", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_usdc_deviation), "k", "usdc_deviation", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_execution_threshold_usd), "k", "trigger", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_cash_reserved), "k", "cash_reserved", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_order_polling_seconds), "k", "order_polling", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_inventory_poll_seconds), "k", "inventory_polling", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_deployment_block), "k", "deployment_block", "", "")

panels.title: USD · Alpaca
panels.description: Alpaca's cash: no rebalance target, so it shows its share of all USD and USDC. Rebalanceable = max(0, withdrawable - reserve).

promQLQuery.expr: sum by (venue, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_alpaca_total, "venue", "Alpaca", "", ""), "col", "cash", "", "")) or sum by (venue, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_alpaca_usdc, "venue", "Alpaca", "", ""), "col", "usdc", "", "")) or sum by (venue, col) (label_replace(label_replace((liq_settings_cash_reserved or (liq_usdc_offchain_gross - liq_usdc_offchain_available) or (liq_usdc_alpaca_total - liq_usdc_offchain_available)), "venue", "Alpaca", "", ""), "col", "reserve", "", "")) or sum by (venue, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_rebalanceable, "venue", "Alpaca", "", ""), "col", "rebalanceable", "", "")) or sum by (venue, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_offchain_inflight, "venue", "Alpaca", "", ""), "col", "inflight", "", "")) or sum by (venue, col) (label_replace(label_replace(round(100 * (liq_usdc_alpaca_total / liq_usdc_total), 0.1), "venue", "Alpaca", "", ""), "col", "share", "", "")) or sum by (venue, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_total, "venue", "Alpaca", "", ""), "col", "total", "", ""))

panels.title: USD · Onchain
panels.description: Each chain's vault and the ratio the bot rebalances on, vault / (vault + Alpaca cash), against the chain's band. It is not a share of all USD: other chains are not in it. Ethereum is the hub wallet Alpaca deposits to and withdraws from, with no band.

promQLQuery.expr: sum by (venue, col) (label_replace(max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_chain_available, "venue", "$1", "chain", "(.*)")) or max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_onchain_available, "venue", "base", "", "")), "col", "vault", "", "")) or sum by (venue, col) (label_replace(max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_chain_inflight, "venue", "$1", "chain", "(.*)")) or max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_onchain_inflight, "venue", "base", "", "")), "col", "inflight", "", "")) or sum by (venue, col) (label_replace(max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_inflight_base_wallet, "venue", "base", "", "")) or max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_inflight_ethereum_wallet, "venue", "ethereum", "", "")), "col", "wallet", "", "")) or sum by (venue, col) (label_replace((round(100 * (max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_chain_ratio, "venue", "$1", "chain", "(.*)")) or max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_ratio, "venue", "base", "", ""))), 0.1) + 0.0001) * (2 * (abs((max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_chain_ratio, "venue", "$1", "chain", "(.*)")) or max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_ratio, "venue", "base", "", ""))) - (max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_corridor_target, "venue", "$1", "chain", "(.*)")) or max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_settings_usdc_target, "venue", "base", "", "")))) <= bool (max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_corridor_deviation, "venue", "$1", "chain", "(.*)")) or max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_settings_usdc_deviation, "venue", "base", "", "")))) - 1), "col", "ratio", "", "")) or sum by (venue, col) (label_replace(max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_corridor_target, "venue", "$1", "chain", "(.*)")) or max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_settings_usdc_target, "venue", "base", "", "")), "col", "target", "", "")) or sum by (venue, col) (label_replace(max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_usdc_corridor_deviation, "venue", "$1", "chain", "(.*)")) or max by (venue) (label_replace(liq_settings_usdc_deviation, "venue", "base", "", "")), "col", "deviation", "", ""))

panels.title: Equities
panels.description: Flags: counter trading, rebalancing and extended hours, green when on, grey when off, hollow when not set. Share balances per venue. Ratio = onchain / total, green inside the rebalance band and red outside it. Exposure = net x live price, empty without a price.

promQLQuery.expr: sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace((max by (symbol) (liq_asset_counter_trading) + 1 or (max by (symbol) (liq_equity_total) * 0 + 3)) * 100 + (max by (symbol) (liq_asset_rebalancing) + 1 or (max by (symbol) (liq_equity_total) * 0 + 3)) * 10 + (max by (symbol) (liq_asset_extended_hours) + 1 or (max by (symbol) (liq_equity_total) * 0 + 3)), "col", "flags", "", "")) or max by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_chain_available, "col", "onchain_$1", "chain", "(.*)")) or max by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_onchain_available, "col", "onchain_base", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_inflight_total, "col", "inflight", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_offchain_available, "col", "alpaca", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_total, "col", "total", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace((liq_equity_total * on (symbol) group_left max by (symbol) (liq_position_last_price_usd)) or (liq_equity_total * NaN), "col", "total_usd", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace((round(100 * (liq_equity_ratio), 0.1) + 0.0001) * (2 * (abs((liq_equity_ratio) - scalar(max(liq_settings_equity_target))) <= bool scalar(max(liq_settings_equity_deviation))) - 1), "col", "ratio", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_exposure_usd or (liq_equity_total * NaN), "col", "exposure", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_unwrapped, "col", "unwrapped", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_wrapped, "col", "wrapped", "", ""))

panels.title: Trades
panels.description: Direct Raindex fills, fills routed through supported adapters such as Bebop, and the corresponding Alpaca hedge trades placed to offset exposure. One row per trade at its latest status; its ⓘ opens the details. Built from the newest 500 status entries, so a busy period can push older rows out of the 30-day window.

panels.title: Rebalances
panels.description: Asset movements between venues to rebalance inventory: equity mints (Alpaca to onchain), redemptions (onchain to Alpaca), and USDC bridges (Base/Ethereum via CCTP). One row per transfer at its latest status; its ⓘ opens the details. A USDC bridge can show the previous status for a while: the exporter stamps each status with the transfer's updatedAt, which is not always later than the one before (bridging starts from initiated_at). Built from the newest 500 status entries, so a busy period can push older rows out of the 30-day window.
The detail dialog of a Trades or Rebalances row: open it from the row's ⓘ.
